title: Hinomori Shizuku — Beautiful Active Idol〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What a beautiful sunset...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hardly come to this area, and it's so peaceful here...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I should really be heading back soon...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The station is just around that corner, so the agency...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Did I not walk past this place a while ago?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
How strange.
I was so sure I would reach the station if I just headed in this direction.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, maybe if I go back the way I came from...hm?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Where did I come from?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'll ask someone for directions...
But there's no one here...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll call Shii! Ah, but she's probably already started her shift at her part-time job by now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I guess I'll have to figure this out on my own.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It can't possibly be that far away...
Shizuku? What're you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, hello, Airi.
Why are you here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Can't you tell? I was asked to buy stuff for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see.
As for me, I was just taking a walk around because the sunset was so lovely.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Taking a walk, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I'm heading back to the agency now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's what you say, but this is the complete opposite direction from your agency. You're lost, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Lost? I'm not lost, I just wandered into a place I'm not familiar with while I was walking around...oh, huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's like the textbook definition of lost!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I guess you're right...
But, if I just go back the way I came from, I'm sure I'll be fine...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Really? Tell me which way you came from, then.
And where's the train station, while we're at it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let me see, this way...or maybe not. That way?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Or not. This way, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The fact that you keep looking at me for confirmation is the best proof that you're hopelessly lost.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I guess I'm lost...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh... You have absolutely no sense of direction, so don't go walking into random roads you're not familiar with.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come on, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't just stand there. Hurry up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You'll be fine once we get to the station, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're taking me there?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you're on your way back home after shopping, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes. I have a lot of things I need to put in the fridge, so hurry up and follow me already.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sheesh... And don't you go wandering off into unfamiliar roads again, like I said just now, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I'll try my best.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't just try your best, make sure it doesn't happen! You haven't learned from your mistake at all!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh... Your love for taking walks can be such a pain.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Maybe, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It feels like you've found me again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, let's go, Airi. Um...this way, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's the opposite way!
